title: 第366章 破界第367章 大丰收
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “猩红妖藤，你这是要带我去哪？”
黑暗中伸手不见五指，
林奇完全无法分辨方向，只能任由猩红妖藤的藤蔓拽着自己的手腕往前走去。
为了以防走失，
他直接把月华铃猫和裂空螳螂收回卡牌空间。
duang～
一声沉闷的碰撞声骤然响起，
“哎呀。”
林奇的额头结结实实地撞在了前方的未知物体上。
他捂住额头，疼得倒抽一口凉气。
“这里有堵墙？”
林奇揉着红肿的额头，伸出手敲了敲面前的东西。
“咚咚。”
一阵沉闷的声响传来。
面前的物体触感光滑而坚硬，像是墙壁，但又带着一丝弹性。
“不对，这种感觉不像是墙，倒像是一个无形的屏障。”
他伸出手掌贴着这层屏障，指尖能感受到一股淡淡的能量波动。
“等等，晶脉虫怎么在里面？”
林奇突然顿住了。
通过卡牌之间的链接，他能清晰地感应到，晶脉虫的气息就在屏障的另一侧，距离他近在咫尺。
就在这时，
猩红妖藤拽了拽他的胳膊，将他的手往下拉去。
林奇顺着藤蔓的方向摸索，没过多久，一根手指就摸到一个孔洞，孔洞边缘还残留着细微的咬痕。
“原来如此，晶脉虫竟然还能咬开屏障，真是太不可思议了。”
林奇真是大为震惊。
他一直以为晶脉虫只能吃石头，现在没想到还发掘了它第二个能力，可以吃屏障。
“可是我该怎么进去？”
林奇尝试召唤晶脉虫出来，
可那小家伙神根本就没有一点智慧，只知道往前跑。
“不行，得想办法进去。”
林奇盘膝坐在冰冷的地面上，从储物卡中掏出一叠又一叠的材料卡牌。
“既然晶脉虫能咬开一个小孔，说明这屏障并非无懈可击，我试试融合一张能穿越屏障的卡牌。”
幽影石、空明羽，薄雾云，一缕清风，灰烬之沙。
林奇快速挑选出适合的材料，一一封印到空白卡牌中，随即启动融合卡。
淡绿色的光芒闪烁，
一张全新的绿色卡牌缓缓凝聚成型，落在林奇手中。
魔法卡，穿云
星级：三星
品质：绿色
卡阶：能够短暂影响屏障
content_en:
"Scarlet Demon Vine, where are you taking me?"
I can't see my fingers in the darkness,
Lin Qi couldn't tell the direction at all, so he could only let the vines of the scarlet demonic vine pull his wrist forward.
To prevent getting lost,
He directly returned the Moonflower Bellcat and Skycracking Mantis to the card space.
duang～
A dull collision sound suddenly sounded,
"Oops."
Lynch's forehead hit the unknown object in front of him.
He covered his forehead and gasped in pain.
"Is there a wall here?"
Lin Qi rubbed his red and swollen forehead, stretched out his hand and knocked on the thing in front of him.
"Dong dong."
There was a dull sound.
The object in front of me feels smooth and hard, like a wall, but with a hint of elasticity.
"No, this doesn't feel like a wall, it feels like an invisible barrier."
He stretched out his palm against the barrier, and could feel a faint wave of energy on his fingertips.
"Wait a minute, why are the Crystalline Insects inside?"
Lynch suddenly paused.
Through the link between the cards, he could clearly sense that the aura of the Crystal Vein Insect was on the other side of the barrier, very close to him.
Just then,
The scarlet demon vine tugged on his arm and pulled his hand down.
Lin Qi groped along the direction of the vines, and not long after, he touched a hole with one finger. There were still slight bite marks on the edge of the hole.
"I see, it's incredible that the Crystalline Insect can actually bite through the barrier."
Lynch was really shocked.
He had always thought that the Crystalline Insect could only eat rocks, but now he unexpectedly discovered its second ability, which was that it could eat barriers.
"But how do I get in?"
Lynch tried to summon the Crystalline Insects out,
But that little guy didn't have any wisdom at all, he only knew how to run forward.
"No, we have to find a way to get in."
Lynch sat cross-legged on the cold ground and took out stacks of material cards from the storage card.
"Since the crystal vein worm can bite a small hole, it means that the barrier is not invulnerable. I will try to fuse a card that can penetrate the barrier."
Shadow stones, bright feathers in the sky, mist clouds, a wisp of breeze, and sand of ashes.
Lynch quickly selected suitable materials, sealed them one by one into blank cards, and then activated the fusion card.
Light green light flashes,
A brand new green card slowly condensed and took shape, falling into Lynch's hands.
Magic card, cloud piercing
Star rating: Samsung
Quality: green
Card level: can temporarily affect the barrier
